text.text_excerpt: UPDATE 8-21-15 My boyfriend and I came back for the second day in a row. Call us crazy, but it's that damn good! This time we ordered the Garlic Shrimp, Grilled Calamari, Lamb Chop, and Vanilla Flan. HOT DAMN! How is it that these were all so incredible in addition to what we had the night before?! It's amazing how flavorful every single dish is, especially since Chef Laurentino cooks everything with a healthy mindset. I don't know about you, but I find it pretty rare to find healthy foods with this much flavor. The lamb chop was just fantastic! And the flan? I think we died and experienced heaven for a second, because that is the BEST FLAN I've ever tasted. The texture and consistency wa...

We love Barcelona Tapas! Every time we come here the food is excellent, the service is great, and the chef comes out and makes sure we are enjoying his food. I think that says a lot about a place, he really wants to make sure that you approve of his food and are having a good experience here. The paella delicious! That's by far our favorite dish. The sangria is good too! Overall, I would definitely recommend this place to any of my friends. It's worth the trek to uptown!

I had a relaxing dinner with my husband at Barcelona Tapas and am hoping to get back there soon. We arrived at around 6:00 and I think we were the only customers there. People did begin to arrive soon after, but I guess we were the early crew. Our waitress came by right away with menus and water. She was very personable and super helpful. The menu is quite extensive and as it was our first visit, we needed some explanation. She was gracious and kind. We were hoping to have paella, but as it takes a while to prepare, we decided to call ahead and place a paella order on our next visit. We had several dishes: garlic mushrooms, Brussels sprouts with Havarti, calamari steak, grilled lamb chops...
